hero.title: Find your gym. Book your class.
hero.subtitle: Fit connects you with gyms, trainers, and classes near you — book and manage your membership in one place.

features.title: Everything you need to stay in shape
features.subtitle: One app for members, trainers, and gyms — from discovery to check-in.

discover.title: Discover gyms & studios
discover.description: Browse verified gyms and studios near you with photos, amenities, and real reviews.

book.title: Book in seconds
book.description: Reserve a class or a session in a couple of taps and get instant confirmation.

train.title: Train with the best
train.description: Find certified trainers, compare specialties, and book one-on-one sessions.

membership.title: One membership, everywhere
membership.description: Manage your plan, track visits, and pay in one place — no paper cards.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free and upgrade as you grow. No hidden fees.

footer.tagline: Book gyms, classes, and trainers across Georgia — all in one app.
